newsitem.title: SPAIN: CAMINERO DROPPED FOR SPAIN'S GAME WITH SLOVAKIA.
newsitem.headline: CAMINERO DROPPED FOR SPAIN'S GAME WITH SLOVAKIA.

text.p: Controversial Spanish coach Javier Clemente has dropped Atletico Madrid playmaker Jose Luis Caminero from the Spanish squad to face Slovakia in next Wednesday's World Cup qualifier.

Caminero was included in the squad that travelled to the Czech Republic last month despite injury, and is expected to start in Saturday's league clash with Barcelona after making a successful return to domestic action.
"I don't want him to feel uncomfortable," said Clemente on Friday.

Real Madrid teenager Raul Gonzalez and Betis midfielder Roberto Rios keep their places after debut performances in Prague, but another newcomer, Athletic Bilbao frontman Ismael Urzaiz, has been dropped.
Taking Urzaiz's place will be Deportivo Coruna forward Javier Manjarin, who had fallen from favour with Clemente in the past few months.
However, Manjarin is unlikely to start the match, leaving Betis' Alfonso Perez and Barcelona striker Juan Pizzi the most probable strike pair.
Pizzi and six other Barcelona players continue to make up the core of Clemente's team, backed up by an ex-Barcelona man, veteran Valencia goalkeeper Andoni Zubizarreta.
Goalkeepers: Andoni Zubizarreta (Valencia), Santiago Canizares (Real Madrid).
Defenders: Sergi Barjuan, Abelardo Fernandez, Miguel Angel Nadal (Barcelona), Alberto Belsue (Zaragoza), Rafael Alkorta, Fernando Hierro (Real Madrid).
Midfielders: Roberto Rios (Real Betis) Julen Guerrero (Athletic Bilbao), Guillermo Amor, Josep Guardiola, Luis Enrique Martinez (Barcelona).
Strikers: Juan Pizzi (Barcelona), Alfonso Perez (Real Betis), Javier Manjarin (Deportivo Coruna), Kiko Narvaez (Atletico Madrid), Raul Gonzalez (Real Madrid).
